args.title: Document the need for S3_ENDPOINT and bucket creation in local setup
args.body:
File: docs/README.md

Add a note in the local setup steps to mention setting S3_ENDPOINT to http://localhost:9000 when using MinIO, and to create the bucket manually in MinIO's console. This will save users hunting for these essential setup details, improving first-time local setup experience.
